says: About 30 comments, tests and lint messages under .github/ci and in .github/workflows/scheduled.yaml cite 0539 as the live rule for no tooling test on the merge line, for example the T1 message `runs no tooling test (0539)`. Slice 7 of the rules and records build marks 0539 superseded by 0584, which puts plain tooling laws back on the pull request, so these messages point a reader at history. The link check reads only `.decisions/NNNN-slug.md` paths, so a bare number is not flagged.
proof: `grep -c 0539` gives changes.mjs 3, merge-line.ts 6, merge-line.test.ts 9, changes.test.ts 7, record.ts 1, shared.ts 1, time-tables.ts 1, required.test.ts 1 and scheduled.yaml 1. check.yaml:32-34 already runs the plain tooling laws their change reaches, as 0584 says.
cost: A person who hits the T1 message is sent to a superseded record, and 0539's old rule reads as the current one.
